name: Realmagic Portfolio
author: Vashudev Vishwas

sections.description:
Realmagic Portfolio is a lightweight and flexible WordPress plugin designed to help you showcase your projects or works in a clean grid layout.

We added new free features like :

  • Portfolio sliders
  • Portfolio Carousel
  • Portfolio Address with URL

We are actively developing new free features including:

  • Filterable portfolio views
  • Shortcode support for easy embedding
  • Elementor and Gutenberg compatibility
  • Social sharing integration

All upcoming features will remain completely free.

Ideal for designers, developers, agencies, and photographers looking for a simple yet powerful way to display their portfolios.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the realmigicportfolio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Realmagic Portfolio in your admin dashboard to create and manage portfolios.
  4. Add the Realmagic Portfolio block or shortcode to display your portfolio on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Will future updates require payment?

No, all planned features will remain free.

Will it support Elementor and Gutenberg?

Yes, upcoming updates will provide full compatibility.
